Astra IPTV Android privacy

How the local library, content connections and optional statistics work on Android and Android TV.

Last updated: 13 October 2026.

  • Controller and scope
  • Local library and storage
  • Required connections
  • Optional analytics and diagnostics
  • Retention and deletion
  • Support and public links
  • External services and policy changes

Controller and scope

Juan Cazalla Estrella is responsible for Astra IPTV. This policy covers Android app com.astra.iptv on phones, tablets and Android TV. For privacy or support questions, email juan.cazalla.17@gmail.com.

Astra is a player for your own authorized sources. It does not supply channels, playlists, films, series or television subscriptions. No Astra account is required. Credentials you enter belong to your provider.

Local library and storage

Playlists, connection details, catalogue, favorites, history, playback progress and settings remain on your device. The library is encrypted using a key protected by Android Keystore. Private credentials and URLs are not published or sent to the developer.

Images, metadata and programme listings may be cached. Selected M3U files are processed locally. Astra does not upload your video files or synchronize the Android library with iCloud. Android backup is disabled for app data.

Required connections

Importing, refreshing a guide or playing content connects directly to the servers you add. They receive your IP address, requests and necessary credentials under your provider's privacy policy. Some sources use unencrypted HTTP; transport security depends on the URL you choose. Use HTTPS when available.

TMDB may receive a film or series title, year or identifier to provide information, credits and artwork. MDBList may receive content identifiers for ratings when configured. These services and image servers receive the IP address needed to respond. Astra does not send them your provider credentials.

Trailers open in YouTube or your browser. Chromecast and Picture in Picture use system or Google services when selected; casting requires the receiving device to access your source. Those services have their own policies.

Optional analytics and diagnostics

Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics, Google services, are used only in configured builds after your choice. Analytics and crash reporting are initially disabled. You can decline both and use every feature, or change each choice independently in Settings. Development and test builds do not send telemetry.

If you accept analytics, Analytics processes a pseudonymous installation identifier, device and version information, language, approximate country or region derived from IP addresses and app interaction events. We measure screens, imports, result counts, favorites, playback controls and duration, waits and fixed error categories. We do not send titles, search text, playlist or provider names, URLs or passwords.

If you accept diagnostics, Crashlytics processes installation identifiers, crash traces, relevant state and device/app technical information. Non-fatal errors use fixed categories. When analytics is also accepted, actions may provide crash context. The SDKs may collect session and performance metrics to diagnose stability.

Astra has no advertising and does not use advertising IDs, GPS location, Google Signals or advertising personalization. This data is not sold or used for advertising. Google processes it to provide the services and may process it outside your country. Installation identifiers allow events to be associated and are not anonymous.

Retention and deletion

Your library stays on the device until you remove a playlist, clear app data or uninstall. Settings can remove a playlist and associated data. Clearing data or uninstalling removes app storage; it does not erase data retained by your provider or Google.

Disabling analytics stops collection and resets local Analytics data and identifiers. Disabling diagnostics stops uploads and discards pending reports; re-enabling may require an app restart. This does not erase reports already sent to Google. Contact the privacy email for help with those data.

The project's Analytics property retains event and user data for 14 months; aggregated statistics may be kept longer. Crashlytics retains traces and identifiers for 90 days before starting deletion under Google's policy.

Support and public links

If you contact support, we receive your email and whatever information you choose to share to answer your request. Do not send passwords or credential-bearing URLs. GitHub issues are public.

Rating-request history remains on the device. Sharing Astra includes a public app link, without playlists, titles or credentials. A rating request does not establish that you rated the app.

External services and policy changes

See the Firebase, Google, TMDB and MDBList policies linked below. This website has no analytics, advertising, forms or first-party cookies. GitHub Pages may record technical information under its own policy. Policy updates will be published here with an updated date.
